api: z3.set_param('proof', True) before Solver(); solver.add(original != candidate); solver.proof()
proof:
mp(asserted(a + b != b + a),
   trans(rewrite(a + b != b + a == Not(a + b == b + a)),
         trans(monotonicity(rewrite((a + b == b + a) == True),
                            Not(a + b == b + a) == Not(True)),
               rewrite(Not(True) == False),
               Not(a + b == b + a) == False),
         a + b != b + a == False),
   False)

api: z3.set_param('proof', True) before Solver(); solver.add(original != candidate); solver.proof()
proof:
mp(asserted(a - b != a + -b),
   trans(trans(monotonicity(rewrite(a - b == a + 255*b),
                            rewrite(a + -b == a + 255*b),
                            a - b != a + -b ==
                            a + 255*b != a + 255*b),
               rewrite(a + 255*b != a + 255*b ==
                       Not(a + 255*b == a + 255*b)),
               a - b != a + -b ==
               Not(a + 255*b == a + 255*b)),
         trans(monotonicity(rewrite((a + 255*b == a + 255*b) ==
                                    True),
                            Not(a + 255*b == a + 255*b) ==
                            Not(True)),
               rewrite(Not(True) == False),
               Not(a + 255*b == a + 255*b) == False),
         a - b != a + -b == False),
   False)

api: z3.set_param('proof', True) before Solver(); solver.add(original != candidate); solver.proof()
proof:
mp(asserted(a + 3 - 3 != a),
   trans(trans(monotonicity(trans(trans(monotonicity(rewrite(a +
                                        3 ==
                                        3 + a),
                                        a + 3 - 3 ==
                                        3 + a - 3),
                                        rewrite(3 + a - 3 ==
                                        3 + a + 15*3),
                                        a + 3 - 3 ==
                                        3 + a + 15*3),
                                  trans(monotonicity(rewrite(15*
                                        3 ==
                                        13),
                                        3 + a + 15*3 ==
                                        3 + a + 13),
                                        rewrite(3 + a + 13 ==
                                        a),
                                        3 + a + 15*3 == a),
                                  a + 3 - 3 == a),
                            a + 3 - 3 != a == a != a),
               rewrite(a != a == Not(a == a)),
               a + 3 - 3 != a == Not(a == a)),
         trans(monotonicity(rewrite((a == a) == True),
                            Not(a == a) == Not(True)),
               rewrite(Not(True) == False),
               Not(a == a) == False),
         a + 3 - 3 != a == False),
   False)

         trans(monotonicity(rewrite((x == x) == True),
                            Not(x == x) == Not(True)),
               rewrite(Not(True) == False),
